s00000.summary: In a rink courtroom, Lev sneers that Adaeze's hospitalized client is conveniently absent
Adaeze and Lev bicker over a doctor's note he claims never arrived
Lev moves to proceed in absentia, producing a waiver her client supposedly signed
Adaeze finds the signature and insists it is not her client's hand
At the bench, Adaeze accuses Lev of forging or allowing the forged waiver
Judge Tran rubs the signature and finds the ink is still wet
Lev flounders for excuses as the judge and Adaeze press him
A clerk appears with a felt-tip pen and admits Lev called it routine
Judge Tran sits Lev down and grants Adaeze's motion to dismiss with prejudice
Adaeze exhales in relief as Judge Tran adjourns court and the disco ball stops

s00001.summary: Detective Odalys enters a rainy taxidermy workshop where a woman sews at the bench
Odalys asks about the museum break-in and lets a probing slip test the woman
Odalys spots a museum key tag on Ingrid's shelf as Ingrid hints she knows
Odalys rises, hand on her belt, and orders smiling Ingrid to drop the needle

s00002.summary: Tamsin wades through the drowned library and finds a humming book while Bram works
Seraph Vane enters through the west door and asks for the keeper
Tamsin quietly slips the humming book back into place and the bees fall silent

s00003.summary: In a salt mine curling final, Abebe's stone dies short of the button
Dez concedes the game while Inez assures Abebe the miss wasn't his fault
Foreman Gus comes down the gallery and orders them to clear the lane
Inez begs for the final end and Gus grants them one stone
Inez steadies Abebe's shaking hands and reminds him to breathe out
Abebe's clean release goes long and touches nothing as Gus checks his watch

s00004.summary: On a riverboat deposition, genial Neely plays friendly while Miles stays guarded
Horace pleasantly questions Neely about the boat over Miles's objections
Horace raises the engine room fire and the eleven men locked inside
Neely hurriedly claims the door just sticks and disowns knowledge
Horace produces Neely's signed work order for an exterior bolt
Horace reveals the contractor is dead and his widow delivered the file
Trembling Neely begs Miles to act; Horace mocks his request for a recess
Neely admits the engine room was meant to be empty for the insurance fire
Horace finally uncaps his pen, writes one line, and ends the deposition

s00005.summary: Riding the funicular, Sabine lays out the timed vault heist plan
Teo frets about an unbribable guard and Sabine teases him
The man in gray offers his name, Halvard, sealing the partnership
As the summit nears, Sabine calms Teo and Halvard calls gloves on

s00006.summary: The giant tortoise market slows and Maeve orders merchants to hold their wares
Dominic grumbles about lost lanterns and trades barbs with Lady Isolde
The shell groans, crates slide, and Maeve orders everyone to the rails as the tortoise rises

s00007.summary: In the closing bowling alley, Rosalind wraps her late father's trophies
Rosalind snaps at Devante to stop clicking the ball return lever
Pearl and Devante squabble fondly over their father's best score
Devante calls the trophies junk and Rosalind tells him to leave them
Pearl laments the buyer turning the alley into a gym until Devante stops her
Devante walks the length of lane nine alone, brooding over the doomed boards
Pearl says Rosalind was meant to close up; Rosalind insists the bank is
Rosalind refuses help carrying the heavy box and brushes off Pearl's worry
Pearl produces their father's old bowling shirt; Rosalind won't take it
Devante carefully folds the shirt and lays it in the box in silence
Pearl buttons her coat, promises coffee at eight, and leaves
Alone, Devante hands Rosalind the last trophy and quietly kills the radio

s00008.summary: Guard Wallace questions why June is in the planetarium booth at two a.m.
June slips on her headset and covers with a flimsy excuse
Wallace shares his late wife's joke about Orion and June genuinely laughs
June whispers to her crew and bluffs that she is praying for her laptop
Wallace reveals he knew about the heist all along and stayed on break
Wallace offers coffee and asks the crew to leave the borrowed telescope

s00009.summary: Down nine in the final jam, Tamara coaches tense Bruise on the bench
Jammers line up and Tamara gives Bruise her final instruction
Dot and Bruise trade insults at the starting line
Dot needles Bruise about praying while Jonas demands quiet
Bruise and Dot lock eyes in silence until the whistle shrieks

s00010.summary: Armed Dez keeps Oksana from the brake while Car Two hangs stalled
At gunpoint Oksana tells Base everything's fine, but Marguerite doubts her
Dez levels the pistol and makes Oksana send Marguerite home
Forced to open the duffel, Oksana finds a steel case on a wrist strap
Ski patroller Tariq walks in, sees the gun, and is made to sit
Dez rips away Tariq's radio so nobody knows he is there
Marguerite sees headlights; Dez aims at the handset as Oksana hesitates
Oksana radios the truth and Marguerite tells her to move the car
As headlights flood the fog, Oksana urges Dez to walk away
Dez kicks over the case, cocks the pistol, and orders her to pull
Oksana pulls the lever and the cable begins to run

s00011.summary: Prudence announces the synergy is insufficient, directionally, to her two staffers
Barnaby and Delphine's fingers touch over a pen and both look away
A pigeon dropping lands; Prudence takes it offline and forbids a mop
Barnaby shows a one-colour pie chart and everyone pretends it is fine
Delphine asks for a lanyard and Prudence defers to an unscheduled review
Barnaby and Delphine file to the broken elevator and wait facing steel

s00012.summary: Tired Birgitta runs the dryer and gives in to Tobias's late-night gummy request
Tobias introduces his stegosaurus Gary to the lone girl, who critiques him
Birgitta gently asks where the girl's parents are and learns she is Noor
Noor panics and begs Birgitta not to call anyone
A breathless man bursts in and Birgitta shields the children
Noor runs to her father, who hugs her and thanks Birgitta
Tobias relays Gary's goodbye and Noor solemnly waves back

s00013.summary: Silas kneels silently beside his dead horse on the salt flats
Connie appears with a canteen and they size each other up
Connie offers water for a name and Silas trades wry refusals
Silas steps closer and Connie reaches for her rifle in a standoff
Silas suspects Connie works for Dutch Halloran and warns of his gang
Connie shares her canteen, saying she's there for the same reason
They trade losses inflicted by Dutch and truly see each other
Connie lays out a plan to sink Dutch's wagon in the brine vats
Silas asks for cartridges and Connie loads him up
Dust rises on the ridge and they head for the vats together

s00014.summary: On a ferry courtroom, the judge admits the manifest after an uneventful morning
Lieutenant Arroyo interrupts with a newly found engine room log
The judge confronts Percy with his signature in the engineer's log
De Luca and Osei clash over the ambush until the judge gavels order
Percy whispers to De Luca, who goes pale and asks who Annabelle is

s00015.summary: Around an empty coat, Hetty asks who last saw Doctor Marrow
Mei-Ling presses Soli about the keys as Bastian contradicts her account
Hetty asks Bastian's whereabouts and Pratt mocks his long cataloguing
Mei-Ling catches Pratt's lie and Hetty notes he still has a key
Pratt needles Mei-Ling for inching toward the coat and muses on blame
Bastian points out Pratt's wet cane and Hetty demands where Marrow is

s00016.summary: A stranger rides into the dry creek where an armed young woman waits
The stranger asks after Cullen Pike and she claims never to have heard of him
She approaches, demands his name, and laughs at Jedediah's church name
Odalys reveals Cullen was her father and she buried him under the pier
Odalys levels her shotgun and says the man who sent him killed Cullen

s00017.summary: Gloria bellows greetings from the balloon basket to no one below
Winnie squeezes her eyes shut and chants not to look down
Gloria frets over a dial, then covers with a call to smile
Gloria hands Winnie the clipboard and tells her not to let go of the burner

s00018.summary: Grandpa Ezekiel jokes with Pippa about falling off boats the right way
Junior wants off the ferry and Ezekiel calls them simply committed

s00019.summary: Magnus leads four through the dark mushroom tunnel, forbidding touching shelves
Zuzu sees caps breathing and the stranger says they dislike light
Abiola flags a discrepancy in the logs as Magnus hurries ahead
Zuzu finds half a boot wrapped in a hairnet on the floor
Magnus claims the boot belonged to a picker who quit
The stranger warns everyone to freeze as rustling rises down the tunnel
The stranger exposes that Magnus locked the gate and Abiola calls it a lie
Zuzu's spilled caps quiver as she begs Magnus to open the gate
Magnus admits the keys open the far door, then the tunnel stirs
The stranger pulls a steel canister and decides they go the other way
